_abundance_note: NanoSim metagenome abundances are percentages of BASES per strain (it fills a base quota per strain). rhea's inputs, recovered from the bases of its stored reads (inputs/rhea_zymo_profile/base_shares.tsv), are the D6300 composition: T0 12% per bacterium and 2% per yeast; T1 variant only (12%, yeast 2%) for half of the species and 6% + 6% (yeast 1% + 1%) for the other half, i.e. species totals constant over time.
_comment: Zymo simulation series for HeteroSV. Each series changes one factor of rhea's Zymo simulation (Curry et al. 2024). 'sv_set' names the variant genomes (step 2); series that share an sv_set have identical SVs and differ only in their reads.

replica.description: rhea's Zymo simulation (pipeline check); rhea's D6300 abundances

low_depth.description: about 15x instead of about 60x per bacterial genome

partial_change.description: every species: variant strain 20% at T0 and 60% at T1; species totals as rhea's (D6300)

uneven_abundance.description: bacterial species abundances geometric over a 15-fold range (random order, seed), yeasts as rhea; species totals constant over time, rhea's T1 composition
